dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.java_completion_processor.rename_and_override_sort_proposals>
<!description: Rename filterAndSortProposals to sortProposals and add @Override annotation in JavaCompletionProcessor.>
<!severity: HINT>
protected java.util.List<org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ICompletionProposal> $methodName(java.util.List<org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ICompletionProposal> $proposals, org.eclipse.core.runtime.IProgressMonitor $monitor, org.eclipse.jdt.ui.text.java.ContentAssistInvocationContext $context) :: methodNameMatches($methodName, "filterAndSortProposals") && inClass("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.java.JavaCompletionProcessor")
=>
@java.lang.Override protected java.util.List<org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ICompletionProposal> sortProposals(java.util.List<org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ICompletionProposal> $proposals, org.eclipse.core.runtime.IProgressMonitor $monitor, org.eclipse.jdt.ui.text.java.ContentAssistInvocationContext $context)
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
